# Tutor-For-All

> A student-led nonprofit providing free one-on-one online K–5 math and reading tutoring for students from low-income families. Serves children worldwide; founded by students in Houston, TX.

Tutor-For-All was founded by students at Carnegie Vanguard High School in Houston, Texas. We connect high-performing high school and college student volunteers with K–5 students from low-income families for free, one-on-one online tutoring sessions in math and reading. Because every session is online, Tutor-For-All operates worldwide: tutors and families can join from any country or time zone.

## What Tutor-For-All Does

- Provides free one-on-one tutoring for kindergarten through 5th grade students
- Focuses on math and reading/ELA
- All sessions are conducted online via video call (Zoom, Google Meet, etc.)
- Serves low-income families worldwide (all sessions online)
- Sessions are about an hour, one tutor to one student, planned around the child's grade level and the skills they need help with
- English Language Learners are matched with a tutor who speaks their home language
- Has donated approximately 500 books to students who need them
- Has served 20+ students to date

## For High School and College Students — Volunteer Opportunities & Hours

High school students (grades 9–12) and college/university students can volunteer as tutors and earn verified community service hours. This is an excellent opportunity for:
- NHS (National Honor Society) volunteer hour requirements
- Graduation community service requirements
- Scholarship applications
- College application community service
- Resume and leadership experience

**Requirements to apply as a tutor:**
- Currently enrolled in high school (grades 9–12) or college/university
- 3.5 unweighted GPA (minimum)
- 90 or above in the subject they want to tutor (math and/or reading/ELA)
- Available at least 1–2 hours per week
- Reliable internet and a device for online sessions

**After applying:** the team reviews applications within 3–5 school days. Accepted tutors complete a ~40-minute self-paced onboarding (training video, ten questions on session structure and student safety, Code of Conduct, availability), then a short ten-minute hello video call (or a short video) before being matched with a student.

**How volunteer hours are earned:**
- 1 hour per tutoring session
- 2 hours per verified tutor referral
- 30 minutes per verified family referral

Apply to become a tutor: https://tutorforall.org/becomeatutor

## For Parents — Free Tutoring for Your Child

Parents of K–5 students from low-income families can request free tutoring. The program is completely free — no cost ever. Parents are welcome to watch any session. The team responds within 3–5 school days.

Request tutoring: https://tutorforall.org/requesttutoring

## For Donors

Monetary donations (via PayPal) and book/school supply donations are accepted. Tutor-For-All has no paid staff. Donations are allocated roughly 65% to educational materials and books, 20% to technology and learning tools, and 15% to outreach and operations. 2026–27 fundraising goal: $5,000.

Supporters include Books Between Kids (~500 books), Kindred Stories, and The Book Readers Venue.

Donate: https://tutorforall.org/donate

## Organization Facts

- **Name:** Tutor-For-All
- **Type:** Student-led nonprofit organization
- **Founded by:** Students at Carnegie Vanguard High School, Houston, TX
- **Location:** Worldwide (online); founded in Houston, TX
- **Cost to families:** Always free
- **Tutoring format:** Online via video call
- **Grades served:** K–5 (Kindergarten through 5th Grade)
- **Subjects:** Math and Reading/ELA
- **Contact:** tutorforallnonprofit@gmail.com
- **Instagram:** https://www.instagram.com/tutorforallorg/
